audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was given to Yorick at 3/10 while whys[4] says Ornn wins the all-in there; 2+ items was given to Ornn while whys[6] says Yorick out-scales.
audit.why: Both rows contradict their own why text, and the packet chart backs the prose on both.
audit.corrected: Row 4 to Ornn (7/10) and row 6 to Yorick (3/10) in both layers.

audit.why: Four spikes: Yorick early, Ornn at 3, Ornn at 6, Yorick at 2+ items on the split — consistent with 54.89% and the corrected chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: The text calls the cage his E ('E-cage', 'shield off his E-cage commit') and never states the decisive interaction with Ornn's E.
audit.why: Dark Procession (W, 20/18/16/14/12s, 600 range) is the destructible wall; Mourning Mist (E, 12/11/10/9/8s, 700 range) shreds armour, slows and marks you for the Mist Walkers. Critically, Ornn's Cleave knocks up when he collides with terrain — and Yorick's cage IS terrain, so the wall he drops to trap you also gives Ornn a guaranteed knock-up. Last Rites (Q, 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s) is an auto-attack reset that heals him.
audit.corrected: Put the cage on W, named Mourning Mist and Last Rites, and stated the cage-as-terrain knock-up.

audit.why: Dark Procession 20s rank 1, Mourning Mist 12s, Last Rites 6s, Eulogy of the Isles 160s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mourning Mist carries a 'dash' flag in the kit file.
audit.why: Riot's own description says Yorick throws a globule of Black Mist — there is no dash. The flag is a tooltip-parsing misfire and no advice was built on it.

edits.before: - Yorick Dark Procession: matchup-defining — Traps you for ghouls. Don’t get caged. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Dark Procession (W): 20s at rank 1 — destructible terrain, so break a segment rather than wait it out. - Mourning Mist (E): 12s, shreds armour and marks you for the ghouls. - Last Rites (Q): 6s heal on an auto reset.

edits.after: Dark Procession (W), 20s, is destructible terrain — and your E knock-up needs terrain, so his cage arms you.

edits.before: Traps you for ghouls. Don’t get caged. Only engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: Trap you with W ghost-wall when you E in, then cage you out of the wave to deny CS and scale

notes: The cage-as-terrain point is the highest-value finding here and was entirely absent: Ornn's Cleave knocks up on terrain collision, and Dark Procession creates terrain, so Yorick trapping Ornn hands him the knock-up he otherwise needs his own pillar for. Remaining 'E-cage' phrasing inside the long early/late paragraphs was left alone to stay inside the length band.
